title: Security & Compliance: Acceptance Playbook and Sign-off Runbook for Private Deploy
creator: Aisha Patel
description: PRD addendum that codifies acceptance criteria, scope boundaries, and the sign-off runbook for SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit logging, and KMS/HSM integrations for Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments. Intended to reduce review cycles by making testing and compliance expectations explicit for Eng, Security, Legal, and Solutions teams.
scope: Inbound: SAML 2.0 IdP integration (metadata upload, SP-initiated + IdP-initiated flows, logout) for Console and API auth
User lifecycle: Optional SCIM provisioning and Just-in-Time (JIT) account creation for customer IdPs
RBAC model: Role templates (Admin, Ops, Developer, Auditor), resource scoping (org, project, model), and custom role creation API
Audit logging: Immutable, tamper-evident audit stream for auth events, API requests, role changes, and key operations; export to customer SIEM via syslog/CloudWatch/Collector
KMS/HSM: Customer-managed key support for at-rest encryption (CMEK), envelope encryption workflows, and optional HSM-backed signing for attestation
out_of_scope: Building a generic SCIM server for all IdP vendors (we will support the most common attributes and document extension points)
Full multi-tenant RBAC across shared Hosted product (Private scope only)
Custom key escrow services for long-term offline archival (consulting add-on)
Hardware procurement for customer on-prem HSMs (customer responsibility)
FIPS certification of our runtime image (we will document controls and provide HSM attestation but not pursue FIPS on our binary in this sprint)

acceptance_criteria: SSO/SAML: Customers can upload IdP metadata and complete both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated logins to Console with matching assertion attributes for name, email, and groups
SSO/SAML: Logout and session invalidation complete within 5s for interactive sessions in 95th percentile under normal load
SCIM (optional): Provisioning requests from IdP result in correct user creation with at least username, email, and displayName fields; mismatched attributes surfaced to admin logs
RBAC: Out-of-the-box role templates (Admin, Ops, Developer, Auditor) enforce least privilege for Console and API routes; audit shows correct enforcement for CRUD on models and project settings
RBAC: Custom role creation API exists and can be exercised via integration test to grant a role limited to 'model:read' within a project

Audit logs: All auth events, role changes, API key operations, and key rotations are captured and immutable for 90 days; logs include timestamp, actor, source IP, request id, and before/after where applicable
Audit export: Customer can enable syslog/HTTPS endpoint export in Console; a sample payload is delivered to configured endpoint within 30s of event in 95% of trials
KMS/CMEK: Customers can register a customer-managed key (AWS KMS/Azure Key Vault/GCP KMS) and demonstrate that primary data encryption uses envelope encryption with the CMEK
HSM integration: For on-prem deployments, HSM-backed signing operations produce attestation certificates and key usage logs; engineering provides instructions and sample test harness
Key rotation: Rotating a CMEK does not invalidate existing ciphertexts; system supports staged rewrap with zero-downtime pattern documented
Security controls: Admin configurable passwordless enforcement, session timeout, and brute-force protection settings available in Console
E2E tests: Automated integration tests exist in CI that simulate IdP SAML assertions, RBAC enforcement, and audit export to a mock endpoint

qa_tests: Integration: Simulate SAML login and SCIM provisioning with test IdP (Okta simulator); verify claims mapping and group sync
RBAC: Run matrix of API calls under roles and assert allowed/forbidden responses; include edge cases for nested permissions
Audit: Tamper test—verify that attempting to alter stored audit entries fails and is detected by checksum attestation
KMS: End-to-end test registering a CMEK, encrypting sample object, rotating key, and rewrapping without downtime
HSM: For on-prem lab, perform signing operation and verify attestation certificate and audit entries
Performance: Measure SAML auth latency under synthetic load and ensure 95p < 150ms for metadata parsing+assertion verification in normal conditions
Export reliability: Configure a webhook receiver that deliberately returns 503 intermittently and verify backoff/retry and dead-letter behavior
rollout_plan: Phase 1 - Internal Alpha (week 1): Deploy to Redwood-internal VPC, run integration suite, engineering hotfix loop
Phase 2 - Closed Beta (week 2-4): Enable for 2 pilot customers with Solutions SE present; collect telemetry and bug reports
Phase 3 - Broad Private GA (week 6): Open to paying Private customers, require signed customer KMS onboarding form for CMEK/HSM
Rollback criteria: Any of the following during Beta: critical auth bypass, loss of audit integrity, or inability to rewrap keys within SLA => immediate rollback and incident review
